entries.paraphrase: INFO trades with the move; LIQ trades against it

entries.text: Intra-bar pessimism: a bar spanning both the stop and target records the stop.
entries.paraphrase: A bar spanning stop and target records the stop
entries.note: D587. One docstring claims ledger 11 and shock 9 together.

entries.text: Stress fill picks the worst close among t0+1 … t0+5 for the trade direction.
entries.paraphrase: The stress fill is the worst close in the window for the direction
entries.note: D587. The docstring of test_stress_fill_picks_the_worst_close_for_the_direction.

entries.text: Session windows: shocks outside Section 3.3 windows and on roll days are excluded.
entries.paraphrase: Shocks outside the session windows and on roll days are excluded

entries.text: DST: window boundaries map correctly to UTC in both transition weeks.
entries.paraphrase: Window boundaries map to UTC in both DST transition weeks

entries.text: Event window: a shock at release + 5 min is flagged; one at release + 6 min is not.
entries.paraphrase: A shock inside the event window is flagged; just outside is not

entries.text: `rebalance_flow(L=3, A=1e9, r=0.02)` = +1.2e8.
entries.paraphrase: Rebalance flow at leverage three and a two percent move

entries.text: `rebalance_flow(L=-3, A=1e9, r=0.02)` = +2.4e8 (same sign as the move).
entries.paraphrase: An inverse product's flow carries the same sign as the move

entries.text: `rebalance_flow(L=2, A=1e9, r=-0.01)` = −2e7.
entries.paraphrase: A negative move at leverage two gives negative flow

entries.text: Zero return gives zero flow for all L.
entries.paraphrase: A zero return gives zero flow at every leverage

entries.text: Point-in-time guard: the AUM used on day t equals the stored value for t−1, and never t.
entries.paraphrase: The AUM used on day t is the stored prior-day value

entries.text: The rolling V and σ_d on day t use no data from day t or later (look-ahead test).
entries.paraphrase: Rolling volume and sigma read no data from day t onward

entries.text: Contract conversion: Q_usd = 1e7 at NQ price 25,000 gives 20 contracts.
entries.paraphrase: Dollar notional to contract count at a stated price

entries.text: DST: 15:00 ET maps correctly to UTC in both March and November transition weeks.
entries.paraphrase: The close maps to UTC in both DST transition weeks

entries.text: Early-close sessions are excluded from the trade calendar.
entries.paraphrase: Early-close sessions are excluded from the trade calendar
